title: Nasruddin and the Carpet
summary: A wealthy merchant refused to let guests walk on his fine Persian carpet....
full_text:
A wealthy merchant refused to let guests walk on his fine Persian carpet.

Nasruddin took off his boots, rolled up the carpet, sat on the bare floorboards, and placed the rolled carpet in his lap: "There now! Your carpet is perfectly safe from our feet, and we can enjoy our conversation in peace!"
moral: Precious carpets are made for human comfort, not humans for carpets.
